candidates.name: Sarah Huckabee Sanders
candidates.summary: Sarah Huckabee Sanders is the Republican governor of Arkansas and the first woman to hold the office. She was inaugurated in January 2023 after serving as White House press secretary under President Donald Trump, and she is seeking re-election in 2026.

career_history.title: Governor
career_history.description: Serving as the 47th governor of Arkansas since January 10, 2023. She previously served as White House press secretary under President Donald Trump.

Healthcare.stance: Sanders has emphasized rural health funding, insurance premium stabilization, and maternal-health initiatives such as pregnancy-care outreach and the Healthy Moms, Healthy Babies Act. Her administration presents these efforts as ways to improve access to care while keeping health costs down.

Economy.stance: Sanders has centered her economic agenda on tax cuts and a pro-growth business climate. In 2026, she signed legislation reducing Arkansas's individual and corporate income tax rates, reinforcing that approach.

sources.title: Sanders signs bills to cut Arkansas' individual and corporate tax rates
Tax Cuts Passed in Special Session

Climate/Energy.stance: Sanders has focused on streamlining permitting for economic development projects, while saying the process should still preserve environmental protections.

Abortion & Reproductive Health.stance: Sanders opposes abortion rights and has promoted Arkansas as a pro-life state while backing state restrictions on abortion and new maternal-health supports. Her administration also highlights pregnancy-care outreach and the Healthy Moms, Healthy Babies Act.

sources.title: Arkansas Named Most Pro-Life State in America for Sixth Year in a Row

Immigration.stance: Sanders has backed tougher immigration enforcement, including the Defense Against Criminal Illegals Act and the use of the Arkansas National Guard to assist ICE with immigration enforcement in the state.

sources.title: Governor Sanders Announces Defense Against Criminal Illegals Act
Sanders Announces Arkansas National Guard to Assist ICE with Immigration Enforcement in Arkansas

Firearms & Second Amendment.stance: Sanders signed a 2025 law requiring annual, age-appropriate gun safety instruction in public schools and open-enrollment public charter schools beginning in the 2025-2026 school year.

Foreign Policy.stance: Sanders has framed several state actions in national-security terms, including a Communist China defense package and efforts to limit foreign-adversary influence over land and state resources.

sources.title: Governor Sanders Announces the Communist China Defense Legislative Package
State Shield Awards Arkansas Top Marks for Defending Against Foreign Adversary Influence

Civil Rights & Equality.stance: Sanders has taken a conservative approach to civil-rights-related issues, including opposition to critical race theory and what her administration describes as school indoctrination. She has also issued symbolic recognitions such as Black History Month proclamations.

sources.title: EXECUTIVE ORDER TO PROHIBIT INDOCTRINATION AND CRITICAL RACE THEORY IN SCHOOLS
Proclamation for Black History Month
Newsroom - Arkansas Governor - Sarah Huckabee Sanders

Education.stance: Sanders has made education a central focus, pointing to Arkansas LEARNS, higher starting teacher pay, merit bonuses, literacy coaches, free school meals, and Education Freedom Accounts as evidence of progress. She has also advanced Arkansas ACCESS as a higher-education reform proposal.

sources.title: Governor Sanders Delivers State of the State Address - Arkansas Governor - Sarah Huckabee Sanders
Sanders Announces Arkansas ACCESS, Higher Education Reform Legislation
Sanders Announces Merit Bonuses for More Than 4200 Arkansas Teachers
Arkansas to Participate in President Trump's Federal Tax Credit Scholarship Program for School Choice

Tech & AI.stance: Sanders has promoted state-government use of artificial intelligence with safeguards around privacy, cybersecurity, transparency, and ethics. She has also opposed a federal AI regulatory moratorium, arguing states should retain authority.

sources.title: Sanders Receives AI Center of Excellence Effectiveness and Safety Report
Following Calls from Sanders, AI Regulatory Moratorium Removed from One, Big, Beautiful Bill

Election Policy.stance: Sanders has supported election-integrity measures such as the SAVE Act, which would require documentary proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote, and she has also promoted election-security funding.

Local Issues.stance: Sanders has emphasized local and regional priorities through her Capital for a Day program and related outreach to Arkansas communities, alongside state efforts tied to rural development, education, public safety, and infrastructure. Her 2026 State of the State also framed those concerns as part of making Arkansas's towns and counties more prosperous.

candidates.name: Colt Shelby
candidates.summary: Colt Shelby is the Libertarian nominee for Arkansas governor in 2026. He is from Cecil, Arkansas, and has said he entered politics after opposing the proposed Franklin County prison and later challenging the timing of a special election for Senate District 26.

summary_sources.title: Libertarian Party of Arkansas nominates 2026 general election candidates
Colt Shelby says prison plan got him into politics
Franklin County resident sues governor, secretary of state over special election timing

Economy.stance: Shelby supports lower taxes, reduced regulations, and opposition to corporate welfare or special deals for large corporations. He frames economic policy around keeping more money with farmers, small businesses, and working families.

sources.title: Colt's Platform - Colt Shelby for Arkansas Governor

Education.stance: Shelby says education policy should preserve parental authority and local control, and he opposes government mandates that interfere with homeschooling, churches, or private associations. In a May 2026 interview, he also said Arkansas' educational freedom accounts should be more income-based and argued homeschooling families are receiving too much money, suggesting a more targeted voucher-style approach than the current program.

sources.title: Colt's Platform - Colt Shelby for Arkansas Governor
Libertarian Colt Shelby seeks another win - independentarkansas.com

Firearms & Second Amendment.stance: Shelby says gun rights are a constitutional right and a natural, God-given right. His platform also says he opposes unnecessary new gun regulations and favors leaving current law in place, including due-process protections for people found to be a danger to themselves or others.

sources.title: Colt's Platform - Colt Shelby for Arkansas Governor

Healthcare.stance: Shelby says parents should have authority in healthcare and family decisions, and he opposes government mandates that interfere with private life. His public platform does not provide a more detailed healthcare policy agenda.

sources.title: Colt's Platform - Colt Shelby for Arkansas Governor

Abortion & Reproductive Health.stance: Shelby has not published a detailed abortion policy on his campaign site. His public comments instead emphasize parental authority in healthcare and family decisions, and a campaign post says Arkansas should address women's health and infant mortality as part of being "truly pro-life."

sources.title: Colt's Platform - Colt Shelby for Arkansas Governor
Colt Shelby For Arkansas Governor on X

Climate/Energy.stance: Shelby has not released a comprehensive climate or energy platform. His public statements focus on criticism of specific data center, wind, and solar projects, which he says raise infrastructure and land-use concerns and do not clearly benefit local communities.

sources.title: Libertarian Colt Shelby says Franklin County prison fight pushed him into politics
Colt's Platform - Colt Shelby for Arkansas Governor

Tech & AI.stance: Shelby has publicly criticized the secrecy around Arkansas data center projects and said it benefits "Big Tech overlords" seeking handouts, not the public. He also says Arkansas should rely on Arkansas companies and people, and he framed a recent campaign video as AI-generated in a social media post.

sources.title: Colt Shelby for Arkansas Governor
Colt Shelby For Arkansas Governor (@Colt_Shelby) / X
Where I Come From: Colt Shelby For Arkansas Governor

Civil Rights & Equality.stance: Shelby frames civil-rights and equality questions through a limited-government lens. On his campaign platform, he says government should not manage private life, emphasizes civil liberties such as free speech and privacy, and supports parental authority while opposing mandates that affect churches, homeschooling, and private associations. The site does not specifically address racial equity, policing reform, or DEI.

sources.title: Colt's Platform - Colt Shelby for Arkansas Governor

Election Policy.stance: Shelby's campaign platform now states that he supports limited, local, and accountable government, with decisions made at the county, city, and community level rather than Little Rock or Washington. It does not provide a specific election-policy agenda on voting access, election administration, or redistricting, so his public position on election policy remains largely unspecified beyond that general local-control framework.

sources.title: Colt's Platform - Colt Shelby for Arkansas Governor
Colt's Platform - Colt Shelby for Arkansas Governor

Local Issues.stance: Shelby’s campaign emphasizes local-first decision-making, with counties, cities, and communities making decisions rather than Little Rock or Washington. It also says government should focus on essentials and leave more room for families, churches, nonprofits, and the private sector.

flags.concern: Fred Love's stance on abortion and reproductive health is marked as 'low' confidence with a generic 'no public position found' entry. Given that this is a major 2026 gubernatorial issue in Arkansas (a state with strict abortion restrictions), and Love is the Democratic nominee, it is notable that no campaign statement, interview, or position paper on this issue was located. This may reflect genuine absence of public positioning, but it warrants human verification—particularly checking recent news coverage, debate transcripts, or direct campaign outreach materials that may not have been indexed by the web-research agent.
flags.suggestion: Human reviewer should verify whether Love has made any public statements on abortion/reproductive rights in interviews, debates, or campaign materials published after the profile's last access date (2026-06-13). If no position exists, the current 'low confidence' entry is appropriate; if one does exist, add it with source.

flags.concern: Fred Love's immigration stance is marked 'low' confidence with 'no public position found.' Given that Sanders has made immigration enforcement a central plank (Defense Against Criminal Illegals Act, National Guard ICE cooperation), the absence of a contrasting Democratic position is notable. This may reflect Love's campaign strategy, but it should be verified.
flags.suggestion: Human reviewer should check recent Love campaign materials, debate coverage, or news interviews for any statements on immigration policy, sanctuary policies, or ICE cooperation. If genuinely absent, the current entry is acceptable.

flags.concern: Colt Shelby's abortion stance is marked 'medium' confidence and relies on a single X/social-media post (status 2042563366095372720) that references being 'truly pro-life' in the context of women's health and infant mortality. The stance description notes he 'has not published a detailed abortion policy' and instead emphasizes 'parental authority in healthcare.' This is appropriately cautious, but the social-media URL should be spot-checked to confirm it actually contains the quoted language and is not a misattribution.

flags.concern: Sarah Huckabee Sanders' firearms stance describes her signing 'a 2025 law requiring annual, age-appropriate gun safety instruction in public schools.' The sources cite HB1117 (Act 229). This is a gun-safety measure, not a gun-rights measure, and the framing is neutral. However, the stance section is titled 'Firearms & Second Amendment' and contains only this one policy. For balance, the profile should note whether Sanders has taken other positions on Second Amendment rights, gun regulations, or constitutional carry—or whether this safety-instruction law represents her primary public stance on firearms. The current entry is not biased, but it may be incomplete.
flags.suggestion: Human reviewer should verify whether Sanders has issued other public statements on Second Amendment rights, constitutional carry, or gun regulations. If the safety-instruction law is her primary 2026 firearms position, the current entry is acceptable; if other positions exist, add them with sources.

flags.concern: Fred Love's voting_record array contains 13 bills with votes and dates. The dates range from 2025-03-01 to 2025-04-16. These appear to be from the 2025 legislative session. The sources cited in voting_sources point to the Arkansas State Legislature website. The bills are described with titles (e.g., 'SB17 - To Create Lux's Law...'), which is good. However, I cannot independently verify from the source URLs provided whether these votes are accurately recorded. The profile should be spot-checked by a human reviewer against the official Arkansas legislature voting records to confirm accuracy of vote tallies and dates.
flags.suggestion: Human reviewer should spot-check 3–5 of these votes (e.g., SB17, HB1974, HB1365) against the official Arkansas State Legislature website (https://www.arkleg.state.ar.us/) to confirm the vote record, date, and bill description are accurate.

reviews.summary: This is a well-researched, substantially sourced profile of the 2026 Arkansas gubernatorial race. All three candidates are covered across 12 canonical issue areas with appropriate confidence levels. Sarah Huckabee Sanders' positions are backed by official government sources and news coverage; Fred Love's stances are grounded in campaign materials and legislative voting records; Colt Shelby's limited public profile is accurately reflected with low-confidence entries where positions are genuinely unavailable. The profile demonstrates good-faith effort to locate positions for all candidates and appropriately documents gaps. Language is neutral and nonpartisan throughout, with no value-laden adjectives or asymmetric framing detected. Candidate backgrounds are internally consistent with cited sources. Minor gaps exist (e.g., Love's abortion stance, Shelby's immigration position), but these reflect genuine absence of public campaign material rather than research failure. The profile's iteration notes show transparent refinement and source-checking discipline.

flags.concern: The stance notes no public position found, but the candidate's voting record includes a 'yes' vote on HB 1252 (Certified Community-Based Doula Certification Act), which is relevant to reproductive health.
flags.suggestion: Consider cross-referencing the voting record with the issue stance to see if the 'yes' vote on HB 1252 warrants a brief mention under reproductive health, even if a broader policy platform is absent.

flags.concern: The stance notes no public position found, but the voting record includes a 'yes' vote on HB 1656 (Amends State Law Regarding Oil and Gas Production and Conservation).
flags.suggestion: Mention the vote on HB 1656 as a data point regarding his legislative record on energy, even if a comprehensive climate platform is not articulated.

reviews.summary: This profile is exceptionally well-structured and maintains a high standard of neutrality. It effectively balances the incumbent's extensive executive record with the challenger's legislative and campaign-based positions. The sourcing is robust, utilizing official government portals and reputable news outlets, and the profile handles the absence of public information for certain issues with transparency and clear confidence levels.

Strong sourcing across all 12 issues with high-confidence citations from official campaign sites (fredloveforarkansas.com, colt4arkansas.org), state government portals (governor.arkansas.gov, arkleg.state.ar.us), Ballotpedia, and credible local news. Candidate backgrounds, voting records, and donor notes are accurately tied to cited legislative and campaign sources. Low-confidence 'no public position found' entries for Love and Shelby are appropriately documented after searches. Neutral, consistent terminology used for all three candidates with no asymmetric framing or loaded adjectives.
